data.name: Grace
data.gender_notes: Grace is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin gratia, 'grace, favour, thanks'. Its root is Latin gratia. A virtue name popularised by the Christian theological concept of grace. Grace is a Latin name meaning “Grace; favour; elegance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Grace expresses “Grace; favour; elegance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin gratia, 'grace, favour, thanks'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grace total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
